sections.Profile:
The "Rose-Bowl" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1951, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, featuring artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1951
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Football
